# History rewrite — 2026-10-13

On 2026-10-13 the owner asked for the `Co-Authored-By:` lines to be removed from every commit message ("remove the
Co-Authored-By lines from the old commits too", then "All 122 commits"). 122 of the 133 commits on `master` carried
one, back to the first commit of 2026-07-17. The messages were rewritten with `git filter-branch --msg-filter` and
`main` was force-pushed. Nothing else changed:

- every commit's tree is byte-identical to the one it replaces, in the same order, with the same parents;
- every message is the original with its `Co-Authored-By:` lines removed and nothing else; authors, emails and both
  dates are unchanged;
- `./verify.sh` passes on the new history, including the guards that walk every admitted corpus state
  (`tools/test-vaic.py`): no admitted receipt changed or disappeared, because no file did.

What did change is every commit hash after the first: 132 of 133. That is exactly the
boundary `CLAUDE.md` already names (a force-push rewrites the universe the guards inspect; the record is not externally
anchored), so it is recorded here rather than left silent.

**The old history is preserved** on the branch `history/before-message-rewrite` (local and on `origin`), whose tip is the
last pre-rewrite `master`, `7c87915`. So the trailers were removed from `main`'s history, not from the repository: the
backup branch keeps all 122, and the older development branches, every commit of which predates the rewrite, keep
theirs (`exception`, `plate3-target`, `repo-hygiene`, `research-journal`, `visual-integration`, `visual-pass` and
`visual-work` locally; `plate3-target`, `repo-hygiene` and `visual-pass` also on `origin`). Rewriting or deleting
those is a separate decision, the owner's. The living documents (`CLAUDE.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/deploy.md`,
`docs/asset-promotion-log.md`, the `backup/*/README.md` and `verify.sh` files) were updated to the new hashes. Three kinds of
record were not, because rewriting them would falsify history: the admitted evidence ledger
(`vaic/evidence/current-browser-observations.v0.json` cites `0e864c1` and `f50148b`), the instrument-v1 audit record
(`docs/audit/`), and verbatim snapshot copies (`backup/instrument-v1/docs/`). Their hashes resolve through the preserved
branch, or through the map below to the commit that now holds the same tree. The pull requests on GitHub point at the
old history as well.
